sn35.72:1.1: yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti
sn35.72:1.2: avusitantena brahmacariyaṃ ārakā so imasmā dhammavinayāti.
sn35.72:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.72:2.3: ahaṃ hi bhante channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti.
sn35.72:3.2: cakkhuṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti.
sn35.72:5.1: sādhu bhikkhu ettha ca te bhikkhu cakkhuṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati
sn35.72:5.2: evaṃ te etaṃ paṭhamaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya tassa …pe…
sn35.72:6.1: jivhaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti.
sn35.72:8.1: sādhu bhikkhu ettha ca te bhikkhu jivhā netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati evaṃ te etaṃ catutthaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya tassa …pe…
sn35.72:9.1: manaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti.
sn35.72:11.1: sādhu bhikkhu ettha ca te bhikkhu mano netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ bhavissati
sn35.72:11.2: evaṃ te etaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ phassāyatanaṃ pahīnaṃ bhavissati āyatiṃ apunabbhavāya tassāti.
